title: Gambit Gone #3
desc:
Two worlds.

Two Gambits.

Two quests.

One for redemption...and one for personal gain.

On the world ravaged by the AGE OF APOCALYPSE, one Gambit risks everything — even his own life — to defend the Morlocks from a force intent on making every mutant pay for Apocalypse's crimes with their lives.

And through the looking glass, another Gambit leads Rogue into the heist of a lifetime! But will it be his life...or Rogue's?!
